items.title: FDA cracks down on illegal ketamine sellers amid nearing ‘psychedelic revolution’
items.summary: The FDA is taking action to curb the illicit online trade of unregulated and unapproved ketamine products through a slew of warning letters.

items.title: Kalohexis confidentially files IPO to back obesity and cachexia portfolio
items.summary: The biotech’s potential launch on the public markets would help fuel development of its clinical-stage, melanocortin-focused pipeline.

items.title: Novo Nordisk signs pact with Vivani for long-lasting semaglutide implant
items.summary: Vivani’s NanoPortal technology delivers medication steadily over long periods of time.

items.title: FDA grants rare paediatric designation to Vanda’s CMT2S therapy
items.summary: The US FDA has granted rare paediatric disease designation to Vanda Pharmaceuticals’ VCA-894A, an investigational antisense oligonucleotide therapy for CMT2S.

items.title: Biocytogen and Whitehawk partner to develop ADCs
items.summary: Biocytogen and Whitehawk Therapeutics are set to develop bispecific antibody-drug conjugates (BsADCs), as part of a global partnership.
